facts.subject: official_game
facts.claim: The official Roblox experience is Chicken Farm (API display name Chicken Farm 🐣), listed at /games/137233438285284/Chicken-Farm. It is a Simulation/Tycoon experience created on 2026-05-23.

facts.subject: developer
facts.claim: Chicken Farm is created by the verified Roblox group Skandi Studios (group id 34492682). The game page credits the experience as By Skandi Studios.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The official description states the core loop: buy chickens and start farming, then convert eggs into cash.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Players merge chickens to unlock rarer chickens.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Chickens keep laying eggs while the player is away, so the farm continues producing offline.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Update 7 added Gem Upgrades that unlock at Rebirth 3, plus 2 new Lucky Blocks, 2 new Rebirths, 4 new Buy Tiers, and balance changes.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The experience is classified as Simulation / Tycoon, with a 6-player server cap.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Paid gamepasses listed on the universe include Auto Collect Money, Auto Collect Eggs, and Double Eggs.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Rolimon's lists Auto Collect Money at 29 Robux, Auto Collect Eggs at 79 Robux, and Double Eggs at 499 Robux. Matching Roblox product-info endpoints for game passes 1860902878, 1862136586, and 1862365605 returned the same prices and IsForSale=true.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: A beginner session starts with a short in-farm tutorial. Eggs drop from a yellow chicken building; walking over eggs collects them. Deposit them on the Deposit Eggs pad, wait for processing shown on a brown board, then pick up cash on the Collect Cash pad.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Chickens are bought by stepping on Buy 1, Buy 5, Buy 25, or Buy 100 pads. Up to 3 chickens can be merged at the Merge pad into a higher-quality chicken.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Lucky Blocks are a source of new chickens. Secondary guides describe buying or hatching chickens from Lucky Blocks, then merging them into rarer birds that raise earnings and fill an index.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Rebirths raise the cash multiplier and unlock extra Buy tiers/items, but a normal rebirth resets cash, Processing Level, eggs, and chickens. A Robux Skip option in the Rebirth menu advances rebirth without that reset.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Sportskeeda lists the first rebirth at 1,000,000 cash (x3 multiplier). Later listed costs scale into billions and above; Update 7 added two new rebirths, so later-tier numbers may have changed since that table.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: Promo codes are redeemed in-game through an ABX button near the top of the screen, then typing the code and pressing REDEEM. Several guides say a short tutorial must be finished before the codes UI is available.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: Codes are case-sensitive. Extra spaces, wrong capitalization, or typos will make a code fail even if it is otherwise active.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: Skipping rebirths leaves the egg-sale multiplier stagnant, which slows buying and merging higher-tier chickens.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: A normal rebirth deletes cash, eggs, chickens, and Processing Level. Rebirthing as soon as the button appears, without enough buy-back cash or without using Skip, can stall early progress.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: Multiple secondary outlets point players to the Discord invite https://discord.com/invite/chickfarm for new codes, and to the Skandi Studios Roblox community for announcements. No dedicated public wiki or Trello was found.

facts.subject: update
facts.claim: The Roblox games API reported the universe last updated on 2026-08-18, matching an in-description Update 7 changelog.

first_10_minutes: Join Chicken Farm by Skandi Studios (place 137233438285284) and complete the short on-farm tutorial.
Walk over eggs that roll out of the chicken building to collect them, deposit them on the Deposit Eggs pad, wait for processing, then step on Collect Cash.
Spend starting cash on Buy 1/Buy 5 chickens, then use the Merge pad to combine up to 3 chickens into a higher-quality bird.
After the tutorial, open the ABX codes button near the top of the screen and redeem any currently valid code exactly as written.
Leave the farm running: chickens keep laying while you are away.
core_loop: Buy chickens → collect eggs → deposit/process eggs → collect cash → buy more or higher-tier chickens.
Merge chickens to unlock rarer ones that produce more valuable eggs.
Use Lucky Blocks as an extra way to obtain new chickens, then merge them.
Optional paid shortcuts: Auto Collect Eggs, Auto Collect Money, and Double Eggs gamepasses.
progression_path: Expand the nest by buying in larger batches (Buy 1/5/25/100) as cash allows.
Merge toward rarer chickens and keep depositing eggs so cash keeps flowing.
Rebirth when you can afford the cash requirement to raise the money multiplier and unlock more Buy tiers.
Update 7 also added extra Lucky Blocks, rebirths, and Buy tiers; later rebirth costs should be checked in-game.
common_mistakes: Typing codes with the wrong case, extra spaces, or after they expire.
Trying to redeem codes before finishing the short tutorial.
Rebirthing without understanding that cash, eggs, chickens, and Processing Level reset unless you pay to Skip.
Ignoring rebirths entirely, which leaves the cash multiplier flat.
Confusing this game with unrelated Roblox titles also named Chicken Farm Tycoon.
faq: Who made Chicken Farm? Skandi Studios (Roblox group 34492682).
Do chickens produce while offline? Yes; the official description says they keep laying while you are away.
How do I get rarer chickens? Merge chickens; Lucky Blocks can also grant new chickens.
How do I redeem codes? ABX button near the top of the screen, then REDEEM. Codes are case-sensitive.
When do Gem Upgrades unlock? At Rebirth 3, per the official Update 7 notes.
Is there an official wiki? Secondary sources report no public wiki/Trello; Discord invite chickfarm is cited instead.

uncertainties: No single live in-game code list was verified. Secondary pages disagree on which codes still work as of 2026-08-19 (for example THANKSFOR100K and 50MVisits appear often, but 666klikes, freecasssh!, earlybirds, 700klikes, adminarbuz, and others are not consistent across Eurogamer, Dexerto, Destructoid, GameRant, Sportskeeda, Rock Paper Shotgun, and PCGamesN).
Exact current chicken rarity names, merge recipes, and chicken-type count are unpublished. Sportskeeda said 'over 36 types' on 2026-07-27; Update 7 later added Buy tiers, so that count may be stale.
Full rebirth cost/multiplier table after Update 7 is unverified. Sportskeeda lists Rebirth 1 at 1,000,000 cash through Rebirth 11, but the official description says Update 7 added 2 new Rebirths.
Gem Upgrade effects, costs, and the full upgrade list are not documented outside the official 'unlock at rebirth 3' line.
Lucky Block tier names and drop tables are unclear (guides call the 50MVisits reward Lucky Block, Basic Lucky Block, or Hacker Lucky Block).
Processing Level mechanics beyond 'exists and is reset by rebirth' were not found.
Index rewards, if any, are not documented; Eurogamer only says players fill out an index.
ABX button placement is reported as top-left by Eurogamer/GameRant/Dexerto and top-right by Sportskeeda.
Exact in-game rewards for joining the Skandi Studios group are not specified beyond the group description.
No official public wiki, Trello, or developer design doc was found.
